application_credentials.description: Follow the [Email HA Google sign-in guide]({documentation_url}). Configure the [OAuth consent screen]({consent_url}), then create a Web application OAuth client under [Credentials]({credentials_url}). The Gmail REST API does not need to be enabled.

user.title: Connect a Gmail account
user.description: Enter the Gmail account you want to use. You will sign in securely with Google on the next screen.

data_description.email: The full Gmail or Google Workspace email address.

auth.title: Sign in with Google
auth.description: Continue to Google to grant Gmail mailbox access. Email HA itself performs only read-only IMAP operations.

sensors.title: Choose Gmail entities
sensors.description: Recommended Gmail entities are already selected. You can change this selection later from Configure.

data_description.gmail_entities: Primary unread, Latest email, and New email are recommended for most homes.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Gmail again
reauth_confirm.description: Email HA needs renewed permission for this Gmail account.

abort.already_configured: This Gmail address is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this Gmail account is already in progress.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timed out while preparing Google sign-in. Try again.
abort.missing_configuration: OAuth application credentials are not configured.
abort.missing_credentials: Application credentials are required. Open Settings > Devices & services > Application credentials, add Email HA credentials, then try again.
abort.no_url_available: Home Assistant has no URL available for the OAuth callback.
abort.oauth_error: Google returned an OAuth error. Check the client ID, client secret, redirect URI, consent screen, and test-user access.
abort.oauth_failed: Home Assistant could not obtain an OAuth token from Google.
abort.oauth_implementation_unavailable: OAuth configuration is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
abort.oauth_timeout: Google sign-in timed out. Try again.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: Google rejected access. Check the OAuth consent screen and add this account as a test user when the app is in testing.

gmail_sensors.title: Gmail sensors
gmail_sensors.description: Choose the Gmail entities you want for this account. Disabled entities remain discoverable and can be enabled here later.

custom_sensors.title: Custom email sensors
custom_sensors.description: Add, edit, duplicate, or delete a sensor that counts matching email on Gmail's server.

email_watches.title: Email watches
email_watches.description: Add, edit, duplicate, pause, or delete a watch that fires an event when arriving email matches.

custom_sensor_common.title: Custom email sensor
custom_sensor_common.description: Only the number of matching emails is retrieved. Matching is performed by Gmail; message contents are not downloaded for this sensor. Blank filters are ignored; choose whether all filled conditions or any filled condition must match. Current rule: {summary}.

data_description.name: A clear entity name, such as RSA unread or Bookings.
data_description.folder: Choose a discovered folder or enter its exact IMAP name.
data_description.from: Match sender name or address. Example: rsa.ie
data_description.subject: Match subject text. Example: booking
data_description.more_filters: Continue to recipient, body-text, any-text, and date filters. Turning this off clears those filters when editing.
data_description.match_mode: All conditions require every filled filter to match. Any condition matches when at least one filled filter matches.

custom_sensor_advanced.title: More custom sensor filters
custom_sensor_advanced.description: These optional conditions use the Match choice from the previous screen. Body and text matching happen on Gmail's server without downloading message bodies into Home Assistant. Choose either a relative date or exact date filters, not both. Current rule: {summary}.

custom_sensor_action.title: Manage custom email sensor
custom_sensor_action.description: Choose what to do with this sensor.

delete_custom_sensor.title: Delete {name}?
delete_custom_sensor.description: This removes the custom sensor definition and its entity after the integration reloads.

email_watch_common.title: Email watch
email_watch_common.description: Fires an event when Email HA observes an arriving message that satisfies the selected Match rule. Catch-up is optional and bounded; message bodies are never included in watch events. Current rule: {summary}.

data.name: Name
data.subject: Subject contains
data.catch_up: Catch up missed email after restart

data_description.catch_up: When enabled, Email HA persists a lightweight UID baseline and checks up to 25 messages that arrived while Home Assistant was offline. Existing mail from before the saved baseline is never replayed.
data_description.match_mode: All conditions require every filled filter to match. Any condition matches when at least one filled filter matches.

email_watch_advanced.title: More email watch filters
email_watch_advanced.description: These optional conditions use the Match choice from the previous screen. Choose either a relative date or exact date filters, not both. Current rule: {summary}.

email_watch_action.title: Manage email watch
email_watch_action.description: Choose what to do with this watch.

delete_email_watch.title: Delete {name}?
delete_email_watch.description: This removes the Email watch and its event entity after the integration reloads.

advanced_account_settings.title: Advanced account settings
advanced_account_settings.description: Gmail IMAP IDLE provides normal near-real-time updates; an internal 15-minute refresh is used only for resilience. The folder below affects Latest email and New email. Gmail count sensors always use Inbox.

data.monitored_folder: Latest email and New email folder

data_description.monitored_folder: Choose a discovered folder or enter an exact IMAP folder name. Inbox is recommended.

error.invalid_custom_sensor: Check the name, folder, filters, and dates. Relative and exact date filters cannot be combined.
error.invalid_email_watch: Check the name, folder, filters, and dates. Relative and exact date filters cannot be combined.
error.invalid_folder: Choose a non-empty folder without control characters.
error.filter_test_failed: Email HA could not test this filter. Check the Gmail connection and try again. Your draft was kept.

abort.too_many_custom_sensors: The maximum of 20 custom email sensors has been reached.
abort.custom_sensor_not_found: That custom email sensor no longer exists.
abort.invalid_custom_sensor: The custom email sensor contains invalid filters.
abort.too_many_email_watches: The maximum of 20 Email watches has been reached.
abort.email_watch_not_found: That Email watch no longer exists.
abort.invalid_email_watch: The Email watch contains invalid filters.

folder_unavailable.title: Gmail folder unavailable
folder_unavailable.description: Email HA cannot access the configured Gmail folder `{folder}`. The folder may have been renamed or deleted. Open Email HA settings and choose an accessible folder, or restore the folder in Gmail.

find_emails.name: Find emails
find_emails.description: Find emails with friendly filters. Blank filters are ignored; choose whether all filled conditions or any filled condition must match.

search_emails.name: Advanced: Search using IMAP query
search_emails.description: Run a raw IMAP SEARCH query. Most users should use Find emails.

get_email_contents.name: Get email contents
get_email_contents.description: Retrieve bounded readable content using a UID from Find emails or the New email event.
